text:
nina_sales: NewBridge asked if we can POC replacing EdgePrompt for their summarize+stream endpoint. Key asks: preserve streaming envelope (they use chunk ids), estimate token billing delta, and complete their security questionnaire. Who can own scope?

omar_se: I can take technical. Quick clarity: do they render partial chunks live? sample from them?

nina_sales: yes, live partials. sample request: ```POST /v1/summarize {"text":"...","stream":true}``` sample chunk: ```{"evt":"chunk","id":"c123","text":"Part of summary","toks":37}```

omar_se: Redwood streams newline-delimited JSON with {"type":"partial","delta":"...","final":false}. We can add an opt-in compat mode that echoes back chunk ids as metadata. Effort ~1-2 dev days + SDK adapter. Note: EdgePrompt's tokenizer inflates token counts; internal compare shows ~+15% avg delta depending on prompt framing.

lee_infra: infra wise: EU-only tenancy ok via dedicated eu cluster or VPC peering. VPC peering + static IPs ~3 business days once DPA signed. On-prem Private deploy longer (~4-6 weeks). We support customer-managed KMS and IP allowlists.

rachel_legal: we'll provide SOC2 link, subprocessor list, and can sign their DPA. Retention default 30 days; can negotiate for audit windows. Procurement often asks for a time-limited credit during migration — expect to discuss a blended rate.

ci_bot: tokenizer-compare job: EdgePrompt vs our models -> median token delta +14% (samples=500).

omar_se: pricing suggestion: for POC offer a capped 30-day trial (e.g., $7k cap for up to 10M tokens). For committed reserved capacity propose a tiered rate starting at $0.0006/token with volume bands. Also recommend enabling prefix caching and batching to offset token delta.

nina_sales: acceptance criteria proposal for POC: 1) streaming parity: chunk ordering + ids preserved for 100 test docs; 2) quality: summary ROUGE within 2% of baseline; 3) latency median chunk <150ms EU; 4) token reconciliation report delivered weekly.

omar_se: test plan: provide an SDK shim example mapping EdgePrompt events -> our stream, run diff on first 5 chunks across 200 docs, and produce token delta report. I'll produce shim demo and smoke tests.

lee_infra: action: open ticket for eu peering once legal confirms DPA; reserve static egress IPs.

rachel_legal: I'll prepare the DPA draft and attach SOC2 + pen test summary; note any special export-control clauses.

nina_sales: can someone draft a 1-page SOW + pricing note for procurement by Weds? Meeting planned Thu 11am CET.

omar_se: I'll draft SOW + include sample curl and the compat adapter snippet.

nina_sales: blockers to surface to NewBridge: potential token-count delta, minor SDK shim required for exact chunk envelope, and peering lead time. If they accept compat shim, risk is low.

ci_bot: ci job: chunk-diff/200 queued, ETA 4h.

omar_se: TL;DR owners: nina (sales) coordinate procurement, omar (SE) build shim + tests, lee (infra) provision peering, rachel (legal) DPA + security pack.

nina_sales: thanks all, tagging @omar_se @lee_infra @rachel_legal.
